Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the quick reply via the signup flow — we're excited to look at Redwood. I'm working with our infra and ML platform folks and they asked for a 10–15 minute technical triage before we book a full product demo. High-level constraints:

- We're EU-first (data residency requirements) and run most model workloads in a VPC in Frankfurt.
- Primary integrations: Snowflake (for vector data), and a short list of third-party OTel tracing.
- Expected inference footprint for PoC: ~3–5 rps steady, bursts to 25 rps during peak tests; average prompt lengths ~350 tokens, KV cache is relevant.

Can someone on your side do a 15-minute call to confirm compat and a few deployment questions (VPC peering, KMS, audit logs)? We prefer mornings CET.

I've attached a 1-page architecture sketch and the contact for procurement (procurement@shoploom.com) who may need to join later.

Thanks,
Alex
Director of ML Platforms
ShopLoom

Alex — Diego here (solutions engineering). Happy to take the 15-min triage. Quick notes so we use the time effectively:

- VPC: we support VPC peering and private connectors; for Frankfurt region we can run both serving and private control plane. If you require on-prem we have an appliance path but that'll change timeline.
- KMS: we integrate with customer KMS for key wrapping. HSM via partner integrations is possible for enterprise.
- Bandwidth/throughput: for 3–5 rps steady with 350-token avg, we typically recommend a single small Dedicated instance for PoC; bursts to 25 rps may need burst capacity or a small autoscale policy.
- Snowflake: vector sync via our ingestion job or direct embeddings push — curious if you plan near-real-time or batch.

If you can paste a single sample prompt and an indication of whether you need streaming/chunked responses, that helps. I can run a very short perf calc live.

Proposed slot: Wed 2028-10-25 10:00 CET — I'll send a calendar invite once you confirm. If procurement needs to join later, that's fine.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
